name: FormActionBar
intent: Page-level sticky form footer — dirty-state status on the left, Discard/Save actions on the right.
when: Full-page create/edit forms that need a persistent save affordance
The form is longer than the viewport and actions must stay reachable

chooseOver.because: Dialog/Drawer/Sheet footers are modal-scoped; this one is page-scoped
Toolbar is canvas chrome (role=toolbar), not a page-pinned form footer
ContextToolbar is a compact top context bar, not a bottom action bar

ownership.expectedWrapper: Sibling of the padded content container inside an unpadded scroll region — never a child of the padded div, which would force negative margins to cancel that padding.

extracted: sticky save bar from the AdminPanel template editor surface
status slot generalised from the template's dirty-count message

lineage.confidence: unset — promoted from an in-repo template usage
notes: resolves core/Core#179: removes the hand-rolled sticky footer and its padding-coupled negative margins in frontend-2.0-admin
layers at z-30; DataTable's bulk-actions pill is z-50 and intentionally floats above it

props.name: status
props.description: Left-aligned status node, e.g. "3 unsaved changes" or "New role — not saved yet".

props.name: sticky
props.description: Pin to the bottom of the scroll region (default). Set `false` to render in normal flow — useful inside a panel that already clips its own content.

props.name: maxWidth
props.description: Clamp for the inner row, matching the form content it sits under. Default `1200px`.

props.name: ...props
props.description: All standard HTML attributes are supported.

usage: Use FormActionBar when you need to provide clear, actionable controls for users. This component signals interactive elements and helps users understand available actions.

FormActionBar should be used for primary actions, secondary actions, or any clickable elements that trigger functionality. Ensure adequate spacing between action elements and use appropriate visual hierarchy to indicate action importance.

anatomy.description: FormActionBar is composed of the following parts:

bestPractices.title: Use clear action labels
bestPractices.description: Write button text that clearly describes the action, like 'Save changes' or 'Delete item'.

bestPractices.title: Avoid vague labels
bestPractices.description: Don't use generic text like 'Click here' or 'Submit' without context.

bestPractices.title: Use appropriate variants
bestPractices.description: Choose button variants that match the action importance - primary for main actions, secondary for alternatives.

bestPractices.title: Don't overuse primary buttons
bestPractices.description: Avoid having multiple primary buttons in the same view, which creates visual confusion.

bestPractices.title: Handle loading states
bestPractices.description: Show loading indicators when actions take time to complete.

bestPractices.title: Don't block without feedback
bestPractices.description: Never disable a button during processing without showing a loading state.
